title: Magik Improvised
description: A RPG Modpack i made, meant to be light compared to others, it's not too big, i'll add more with time.
body:
# **MAGIK IMPROVISED**

A semi-RPG modpack, focussing on a rfresh feel withouth the wieght of hundred of mods!
Planned to have long term objectives, filled with new biomes and dungeons, along new creatures to make the world more lively!

Made to be enjoyed, not rushed.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
### Short term Plans for the modpack:

Checking for Multiplayer, essentials or localhosting, comability, if it is additonal mods will be added

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

### **KNOWN ISSUES**
_Frame Drops_ - Cause: Distant horizions
Solution: Lower DH LODs distance, change generating alghorithm to the slower option


_Tags Not loading_ - Cause: Unknown
Solution: Unknown as well
